note.es: Miercoles 17:39 CT (franja 17:30, vigila pre-asia). La corrida pre-asia SI salio a tiempo (commit 22:09Z, heartbeat 22:09Z, re-disparo sin cambios materiales) antes de que empezara el corte, asi que no hay catch-up. Pero desde ~22:00-22:10 UTC la tuberia de Netlify dejo de refrescar: snapshot a 54 min (VIEJO, umbral 35), webhook silencioso a 99 min (umbral 60), feed muerto en los 5 simbolos (99-100 min), orb muerto en ES/GC/NQ/YM (99 min) y regime muerto en los mismos 4 (125 min); CL sigue con orb frozen (pdh/pdl desfasado del feed desde el 17-nov, racha larga ya reportada) y su regime solo stale (105 min). trendcl tambien degradado (stale en NQ/ES, dead en GC/CL/YM). News ok (79 min, 20 eventos) y scalp CC ok (ingest 55 min, snapshot 69 min): ambos corren por fuera de esta tuberia. Pushes limpios: 9 present, 2 duplicados (re-checks normales de pre-asia), 0 missing, 1 pending (este watchdog). Journal fresco (~21 min). Zonas: YM y CL superan ratio 0.9 pero sus verdicts son AVOID con razon explicita de 'fuera de alcance', asi que no es reach.unactionable. Se notifica por status down: revisar sa-bus-snapshot/session-feed en Netlify.
note.en: Wednesday 17:39 CT (17:30 slot, watches pre-asia). The pre-asia run DID go out on time (commit 22:09Z, heartbeat 22:09Z, re-fire with no material changes) before the outage started, so no catch-up is needed. But since ~22:00-22:10 UTC the Netlify pipeline stopped refreshing: snapshot is 54 min old (VIEJO, threshold 35), webhook silent at 99 min (threshold 60), feed dead across all 5 symbols (99-100 min), orb dead on ES/GC/NQ/YM (99 min) and regime dead on the same 4 (125 min); CL's orb stays frozen (pdh/pdl off from the feed since Nov 17, a long-running streak already reported) and its regime is only stale (105 min). trendcl is degraded too (stale on NQ/ES, dead on GC/CL/YM). News is ok (79 min, 20 events) and Scalp CC is ok (ingest 55 min, snapshot 69 min): both run outside this pipeline. Pushes are clean: 9 present, 2 duplicated (normal pre-asia re-checks), 0 missing, 1 pending (this watchdog). Journal is fresh (~21 min). Zones: YM and CL exceed a 0.9 reach ratio but their verdicts are AVOID with an explicit 'out of reach' reason, so this is not reach.unactionable. Notifying for the down status: check sa-bus-snapshot/session-feed on Netlify.
